current_summary: Tarvos deploys AI-powered automated traps using computer vision to identify agricultural insect pests in real time. Monitors Spodoptera caterpillars in soybean, corn, and cotton; pilot across 50,000 ha in Mato Grosso achieved 20%+ pesticide reduction.

current_one_liner: Microbial risk mapping for food and pharma using DNA sequencing, PCR-LAMP and AI to predict contamination before it happens.
current_summary: Neoprospecta combines 16S/ITS DNA sequencing, PCR-LAMP, and AI to map microbial contamination risks in food and pharma production. Neobox on-site sequencer and Biome Quality software enable predictive microbiological control; acquired by bioMerieux in 2025.

current_summary: Cellertz Bio builds a generative biology platform combining single-cell ML, deep learning molecule synthesis (CodonScope), and cell therapy engineering to develop data-driven cancer biotherapeutics targeting gene regulatory networks.

current_summary: HapiSeeds combines bioinformatics gene discovery (HapiFinder), non-transgenic gene editing (HapiGenes), and RNA biomarkers (HapiMarkers) to raise crop productivity. Maize field trials showed 16% grain-weight gains and 40% more CO2 sequestration.

current_one_liner: Aptah Bio's RNA WiCo platform simultaneously corrects genome-wide RNA processing errors, eliminating multiple faulty…
current_summary: Aptah Bio's RNA WiCo platform simultaneously corrects genome-wide RNA processing errors, eliminating multiple faulty mRNAs and toxic proteins in one compound. Lead asset APT20TTMG targets Alzheimer's; platform extends across cancer and neurodegenerative indications.

current_summary: NeoMed AI platform (Kardia for hospitals, Octopus for clinics) automates ECG and cardiac exam analysis to detect atrial fibrillation and acute MI. Delivers 90x faster reports and 30% cost reduction; active in 1,500+ Brazilian institutions including DASA and Fleury.

current_one_liner: Digital maternal and women's health platform for remote care and monitoring.
current_summary: Brazilian digital care platform for women and family medicine, automating maternal health tracking, appointments and remote monitoring. Connects pregnant women and mothers with healthcare professionals through telehealth and AI-powered health coaching for prenatal and postnatal care.

current_summary: MZP Tecnologia (Bariloche) developed a portable point-of-care coagulation analyzer that measures blood viscosity from a single drop via a disposable micro-machined chip, enabling fast cardiovascular and clotting screening outside the lab.

current_summary: Biotrop produces Bradyrhizobium-based inoculants enabling biological nitrogen fixation in soybeans, replacing up to 240 kg/ha of synthetic nitrogen fertilizer. Acquired by Belgium Biobest in 2023 for $569M; serves row-crop farmers across Brazil and South America.

current_summary: Manufactures Shrimpbox, a 40-foot containerized AI-automated shrimp farm using zero-discharge biofloc technology that grows up to 1.5 metric tons of antibiotic-free shrimp per unit annually, enabling land-based sustainable production near urban markets.

current_summary: Uses soil microbiome genomics and AI-powered analytics to prescribe optimized biological crop input combinations, measuring and improving Biological Capital in agricultural soils to raise yields and sustainability for farmers across Mexico and Latin America.

current_summary: Aimirim applies AI, digital twins, and IoT sensors to optimize industrial fermentation and energy processes in sugarcane biorefineries. Platform boosts ethanol yield and steam efficiency without full reinstrumentation, serving clients like Raizen with guaranteed ROI.

current_summary: Developed the FDA-cleared MARS magnetic robotic surgical platform using dual magnet-controlled arms and Dynamic Magnetic Positioning to perform laparoscopic bariatric, cholecystectomy, and colorectal surgeries with fewer incisions and no camera assistant needed.

current_summary: Extracts bioactive compounds from Patagonian seaweeds to formulate plant biostimulants that enhance crop yield, improve stress tolerance, and support sustainable agriculture, targeting global growers seeking natural inputs to boost productivity without synthetic chemicals.

current_one_liner: Develops and produces biopesticides based on Trichoderma, Bacillus thuringiensis, and other microbial strains to…
current_summary: Develops and produces biopesticides based on Trichoderma, Bacillus thuringiensis, and other microbial strains to replace chemical pesticides in crop protection, serving farmers in Chile and Latin America seeking residue-free, regulatory-compliant biological inputs.

current_one_liner: Combines Trichogramma pretiosum biocontrol cards with the SaveIn digital platform to predict and suppress crop pest infestations.
current_summary: BIoIn combines Trichogramma pretiosum biocontrol cards (Trichocard) with the SaveIn digital pest-monitoring platform to predict and suppress crop pest infestations in soy, corn, and rice. Predictive algorithms time biological interventions before economic damage thresholds.

current_summary: NAIAD Drug Design applies deep learning and structure-based virtual screening to discover small-molecule GPCR modulators. STYX platform predicts biased signaling pathways across billions of candidate molecules before any cellular testing, targeting CNS and metabolic disease. Backed by Green Rock.

Strategic partnership with Teva for oncology biosimilars (Oct 2024). Mature corporate — not early-stage startup.

current_summary: Terragene manufactures rapid biological and chemical indicators — including a 7-second steam sterilization test — paired with cloud-connected readers and software to give hospital CSSDs real-time, traceable sterilization validation replacing manual visual checks.

current_one_liner: Discovers RNA-based bioactive functional ingredients from natural sources using the Serkanto-AI platform for supplements and functional foods.
current_summary: Kresko RNAtech (Rosario) extracts bioactive dietary RNA from bovine milk, herbs, and mushrooms using its AI-powered Serkanto platform to create functional ingredients for sleep, stress, and beauty supplements sold B2B to food, dairy, and cosmetics companies.

current_one_liner: AI-powered chronic disease management platform focused on diabetes in Mexico.
current_summary: Mexican digital health platform for chronic condition management, with a focus on diabetes care. Combines wearable glucose monitoring, AI-driven coaching and care team coordination to help patients manage metabolic diseases. Targets under-served populations with limited access to specialist care.

current_summary: Argentine immunotherapy company founded by Fundación Instituto Leloir scientists. Developing biologics for rare infectious diseases including hemolytic uremic syndrome (Phase III AR+EU) and hantavirus mRNA vaccine with Sinergium. Part of Grupo Insud.

current_summary: Brazilian agronomy management platform for planning, monitoring and optimizing agricultural operations. Provides digital field books, agronomic prescriptions, satellite-based crop scouting and compliance reporting for farms of all sizes. Focused on mid-scale Brazilian producers.
